exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosis by IADPSG criteria
cohort: 25,674 pregnant women attending the Peking University First Hospital (PUFH)
finding: Among Chinese women with mild GDM (FPG<4.4 mmol/L), there was no difference in macrosomia or neonatal hypoglycemia incidence between those treated, untreated, and without GDM, but the cesarean delivery rate was significantly higher in the untreated GDM group.
mod_finding: Rate of cesarean delivery in the untreated GDM group 59.7% was significantly higher compared to both with treated GDM (48.4%) and the non GDM group (47.6%).
